blocks.text: CALAPAN CITY, Oriental Mindoro — The municipal government of Naujan in Oriental Mindoro has tightened measures to prevent the entry and spread of African swine fever (ASF), including a temporary ban on the entry of live pigs for various purposes, according to its information office on Thursday. The measures are contained in Municipal Executive Order No. 26-040 signed by Mayor Henry Joel C. Teves on Sept. 29. The order seeks to strengthen prevention, monitoring, biosecurity, and enforcement measures to protect hog raisers, food security, and livelihoods in the municipality.
